critique: The rain-slick industrial towers, rust plates, neon signage, and magenta-trailing magpie solver turn a familiar maze algorithm into a compelling cyber-noir ecosystem with a strong teal–amber–pink pulse. The rigid rectangular maze still reads as a conventional HUD panel, so letting corridors branch like luminous vines through the pipes—and enlarging or meaningfully integrating the barely visible guinea pig—would make the cyber-nature fusion more surprising and coherent.
